title: Venus dialogue — 15 s, Google Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash (one clip, native audio)

scenes.prompt: Cinematic sci-fi romance, photorealistic, keep both characters exactly as in the image: the alien prince with blue-violet skin, glowing golden facial markings, golden eyes and long silver hair in black-and-gold armor, and the young woman with dark braided hair, a golden leaf hair piece and a golden embroidered dress; futuristic city at sunset with a huge golden planet. Medium two-shot, then gentle alternating close-ups, keep both faces visible. The prince looks into her eyes, smiles warmly and says in a warm, gentle male voice: "I have crossed a thousand worlds... but I never expected to find you." She listens, smiles, then asks playfully in a soft female voice: "Are you always this mysterious?" He laughs softly and answers: "Only when I meet someone special." She laughs naturally and looks into his eyes. Natural blinking, subtle head movements, accurate lip sync, soft romantic orchestral music and gentle wind. No subtitles, no text, no extra people.
